integrity: Original exact enumeration and asymptotic analysis presented with named earlier idempotent/regularity results credited as prior work. No external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Idempotent centralizers inside the order-preserving full contraction monoid only. Uniform random idempotents, not uniformly random monoid elements. Potential undiscovered older equivalent enumeration; finite computational checks are not infinite proofs.
title: Centralizer profiles and a quadratic limit law for idempotent finite-chain contractions
